Package com.hkust.marketplace.ui

Class NotificationDot

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.ui.NotificationDot
public final class NotificationDot extends Object
The red dot on a portal's Notifications button, with the number of unread notifications, the same in all three portals (assumptions register 92). It shows UC4 step 2's "unread" mark before the board is opened. The number is NotificationService.getUnreadCount(); at zero the dot is hidden. Opening the board changes nothing: only marking notifications as read lowers the number (UC4 Special Requirement 3). 

 NotificationDot.attach(btnNotifications, new NotificationService()); // in the dashboard's initialize()
 NotificationDot.update();                                           // in its show(title, content)
The dot also updates when its dashboard appears in the window, the NotificationBoard updates it after marking, and LiveUpdates after the borrowing-deadline timer has sent a reminder or returned an item (UC12). A change caused by the user's own action, such as an admin's account change that every admin is told about, shows at the dashboard's next screen.

Like LiveUpdates, this is the Observer pattern in its simplest form (Lecture 17): the dot of the dashboard on show is the one observer, and attaching a dot replaces the one before it. When its dashboard leaves the window (logout), it is forgotten. Use it on the JavaFX thread.
